value.name: drives out toward Bryn Mawr
value.description: Asha leaves the garage and drives west toward Bryn Mawr with the briefcase beside her.
evidence: her car started on the first turn of the key, the dashboard clock reading eleven-twenty-three when she pulled out onto the empty street. She drove west toward Bryn Mawr with the briefcase belted into the passenger seat beside her

value.name: realizes she has no plan for her sister
value.description: While driving, Asha realizes she still has not decided what to say to her sister when she arrives.
evidence: somewhere past the river she realized she had not yet decided what she would say to her sister when she got there

value.name: pulls over to hesitate
value.description: Asha pulls onto the shoulder and stops the car, pausing before continuing.
evidence: Asha pulled the car onto the shoulder before she could think better of it, gravel ticking under the tires as she let it roll to a stop

value.name: studies the briefcase
value.description: Asha stares at the belted briefcase, sensing the Serrano papers inside belong to the past.
evidence: The briefcase sat belted in the passenger seat the way a person would sit, and she looked at it for a long moment without touching it, the Serrano papers inside already feeling like something that belonged to yesterday

value.name: resumes driving toward Bryn Mawr
value.description: After a pause, Asha gets back on the road as the Bryn Mawr exits approach.
evidence: When she pulled back onto the road the dashboard clock had gone past eleven-forty, and the exit signs for Bryn Mawr started coming up faster than she was ready for

value.name: opens her coat
value.description: At a stoplight, Asha unbuttons her coat and lets it fall open as she feels the car's heat.
evidence: At the next stoplight Asha worked the top button of her coat free, then the next, until the wool fell open against her throat and she could feel the car's heat for the first time since she'd left the garage

value.name: opens the glovebox
value.description: Asha leans over the briefcase and opens the glovebox to search beneath the papers and map.
